name: Vaduz (Liechtenstein)
description: A hanging banner divided lengthwise into three stripes of red, white and red.
history: Adopted on 31 July 1932 together with the municipality's first arms under Prince Franz I, and reconfirmed on 26 July 1978 by Prince Franz Josef II. The municipality describes it as red-white over red; flown as a hanging banner it reads as red-white-red stripes.
